questions.question: Why does the report upload step use `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`?
options: It makes the upload faster
Without it, the step is skipped when the tests fail
Artifacts can't be uploaded without a condition
It stops the report from being uploaded twice
questions.explanation: Steps are skipped after an earlier failure by default, and a failed run is when you need the report most.

questions.question: A test fails once, then passes on retry. What does the run do by default?
options: It exits with code 1
It runs the whole suite again
It reports the test as flaky and exits with code 0
It marks the test as skipped
questions.explanation: Flaky tests don't fail the run unless you pass `--fail-on-flaky-tests` or set `failOnFlakyTests` in the config.

questions.question: What happens to a matrix with the default `fail-fast` setting when one job fails?
options: GitHub cancels the jobs still in progress
The failed job retries on another runner
The other jobs continue, and the workflow passes
The matrix restarts from the first job
questions.explanation: `fail-fast` is on by default. Set it to `false` to see whether a failure affects one environment or all of them.

questions.question: Your tests run in the official Playwright image, but the browsers can't be found. What is the most likely cause?
options: The job is missing `--ipc=host`
The image has no browsers until you install them
The report folder wasn't mounted
The image tag doesn't match the project's `@playwright/test` version
questions.explanation: Each release expects its own browser builds, so the image tag and the package version must be upgraded together.

questions.question: You run `docker run playwright-tests` on a CI runner where `CI` is set. What does `process.env.CI` contain inside the container?
options: The same value as on the runner
Nothing, unless you pass it with `-e CI`
Always `true`, because the image sets it
The name of the CI provider
questions.explanation: Containers don't inherit the host's environment variables, so CI-only settings such as retries won't apply unless you pass the variable in.
